threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just hopping on the Overground like a local—it’s a dead giveaway you’re fresh off the boat.
Last night on the 59, a bloke tried to convince everyone that pineapple on pizza is a crime. The driver just laughed and blasted the horn.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy playing the accordion at 3 AM outside my window while a group of friends debated the best kebab spots. Pure Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a kebab shop that doubles as an art gallery, showcasing local artists right alongside the döner.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their nonchalant reaction to BART delays. Tourists are still checking their watches; locals just grab a burrito and wait it out.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 at 16th and Mission yesterday, bus filled to the brim with folks in costume heading to a gig—mix of laughter and spilled coffee.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can stroll through Parc Güell and soak in the art, but miss the little murals tucked between the houses in Gràcia’s back alleys.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to sit at the bar when ordering a drink. Locals know that's where the real conversations happen.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still ask for directions to the nearest tube, while everyone knows it’s a bus or a bike that gets you where you need to go.
Last night on the 59, a guy sat serenading everyone with his ukulele. Most just nodded off, but a couple joined in. Brixton magic, even at 3 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy in a full tuxedo pulling a wheeled suitcase of fresh bagels down Hermannstraße at 3 AM. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club open at 7 AM on a Monday, filled with tired ravers who just can’t quit the weekend vibe. Totally unique energy.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they calmly mention a BART breakdown like it’s just another Tuesday morning. The visitors panic, but we’re already making plans to walk.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a guy in a tuxedo arguing with a street performer over who’s the real star of the city. Only here, folks.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every plaza is a party spot. Most locals avoid Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia after dark; it turns rowdy with street performers.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still using their cameras on the metro instead of just enjoying the ride. Noticed a lot of them trying to catch that perfect street shot.
